name: Black Equation
detailed_description:
Black Equation: A Branching Dark Fantasy & Sci-Fi Visual Novel.

Welcome to Highgard.

Created by a solo indie developer, Black Equation is a uniquely vast and deeply non-linear interactive fiction adventure. This isn't just a story; it's a living tapestry woven from your choices, offering two distinct playable paths within one epic saga.

Explore Highgard, shaping its destiny through profound choices and unique experiences. Will you unravel biological secrets in a sci-fi quest of scientific discovery, or delve into epic fantasy through fragmented memories of a colossal creature? Every decision matters, affecting the narrative and leading to multiple endings.

Prepare for a journey where every choice matters, and every secret discovered reshapes your understanding of both science and destiny.

Dive Deeper into Highgard in Black Equation, a story-rich text-based game with dynamic narrative and consequential choices.

Start Your Story:

  • Part 1: The Analysis of Form

    • Journey: Delve into a realm of scientific exploration. You will meticulously examine the remains of a colossal creature, unraveling its biological secrets through precise observation and deduction.

    • Gameplay: This section unfolds like a scientific journal, demanding your intellect to navigate medical/anatomical procedures.

    • Genre: Sci-Fi.

  • Part 2: Echoes from Within

    • Journey: Embark on an epic fantasy adventure through Highgard, a narrative tapestry woven from the creature's own fragmented memories.

    • Gameplay: Your path here will be shaped by profound choices, guiding characters through a world of magic, intrigue, and personal sacrifice. Every decision dramatically influences the unfolding story, as choosing one path may lead to unseen events and skipped narrative fragments in others, urging you to explore every possibility.

    • Genre: Fantasy.

Explore a World of Depth:

  • Vast and Non-Linear: Experience over 29 chapters of story-rich, text-based gameplay, offering thousands of unique textual variations based on your choices.

  • Consequential Choices: Every decision matters, subtly shaping the narrative and leading to multiple endings.

  • Unique Art & Sound: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world brought to life with anime-style character portraits and environmental art. Listen to unique character ballads – haunting original soundtracks that reflect the soul of each character, available at your discretion.

  • Rich & Complex Themes: Delve into a lore-rich medieval world filled with dark fantasy, psychological drama, emotional depth, mystery, war, and conspiracy. Experience tragic personal journeys, themes of identity, forbidden love, LGBTQ+ narratives, and encounters with the supernatural (including zombies / undead).

A Literary Journey:

Based on the Finnish novel "Varjot Ylvägardin yllä", this game expands upon its universe, offering a new dimension to its narrative.

What destiny will you forge?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: VR headsets are not compatible with this game.
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard recommended. Touchscreen not tested. Note: If you see a Windows warning, choose "More Info" → "Run anyway".
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 or DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: VR headsets are not compatible with this game.
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard recommended. Touchscreen not tested. Note: If you see a Windows warning, choose "More Info" → "Run anyway".

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or later
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard recommended. Touchscreen not tested. Note for macOS users: If the game doesn't launch, right-click the app → Open → Confirm. If that doesn't help, run this in Terminal: sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine "MacOS/Black Equation".
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple Silicon M1/M2 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus/Xe Graphics or AMD Radeon
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard recommended. Touchscreen not tested. Note for macOS users: If the game doesn't launch, right-click the app → Open → Confirm. If that doesn't help, run this in Terminal: sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine "MacOS/Black Equation".

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E6600 / AMD Athlon 64 X2 6400+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 and 512 MB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: VR headsets are not compatible with this game.
  • Additional Notes: Required: Steam client installed. Note for Linux users: If the game doesn't launch, make the file executable using: chmod +x "Black Equation-2_1_0-linux.AppImage", or enable it via right-click → Properties → Permissions → "Allow executing file as program".
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Phenom II X4 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: VR headsets are not compatible with this game.
  • Additional Notes: Required: Steam client installed. Note for Linux users: If the game doesn't launch, make the file executable using: chmod +x "Black Equation-2_1_0-linux.AppImage", or enable it via right-click → Properties → Permissions → "Allow executing file as program".
